deck: COUNTY SCRIPTS, STATUTORY RATES, REDEMPTION CLOCKS AND OVER-THE-COUNTER LEFTOVERS
LIEN YIELD VERSUS DEED DISCOUNTS, PRICED AGAINST TITLE TRAPS AND ATTORNEY COSTS
site_ui.lead: Practitioners show how a county sells unpaid property taxes as a first-position certificate that pays a state-set rate of 12 to 36 percent when the owner redeems, which they put at about 95 percent of the time, and how a smaller set of deed and redeemable-deed plays turns unredeemed parcels into property bought at 10 to 20 cents on the dollar.
site_ui.summary: All 12 chapters synthesize 192 verbatim YouTube practitioner testimonies, each claim carrying timestamped inline attribution to the speaker and video it came from. Together they span foundations, lien-versus-deed models, state playbooks, auction formats, online and over-the-counter buying, due diligence, foreclosure and quiet title, risks, federal tax liens, court challenges, and portfolio funding.

flow: Call the county for last year's lien count and attendance; 200 to 500 liens with 20 bidders beats 30 liens with 50, and starting small in one county teaches how its auction works.
Read the county's terms, deadlines and deposits, and check the state's interest ceiling or penalty, surplus and redemption rules before bringing a dollar.
Look at every property and confirm its value, search municipal liens and code violations that survive the sale, and pass on landlocked lots and demolition-grade structures.
Add the lien or deed price to roughly $2,000 to $5,000 in attorney and foreclosure fees and make sure the total sits well under resale value, with an exit strategy before you bid.
BID OR BUY OVER THE COUNTER

Bid for yield on parcels likely to redeem or for property on those less likely to, mind Florida's 5 percent floor that a 0 percent bid forfeits, and work the unsold list that appears about 30 days after the sale.
Log every redemption and expiration date on the day you buy, act before deadlines such as Florida's seven-year deed application lapse, and move foreclosed houses with big signs and Craigslist.
